#   filename:  <stdin>

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, RootModel


class Handler(RootModel[Callable[[int], int]]):
    root: Callable[[int], int] = Field(..., title='Handler')


class Hook(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., title='Name')
    callback: Callable[[int], int] = Field(..., title='Callback')


class Probe(BaseModel):
    check: Callable[[str], bool] | None = Field(..., title='Check')


class Task(BaseModel):
    run: Callable[[], None] = Field(..., title='Run')


class Holder(BaseModel):
    hook: Hook
    probe: Probe
    task: Task
    handler: Handler


class Inner(BaseModel):
    callback: Callable[[int], int] = Field(..., title='Callback')


class Outer(BaseModel):
    inner: Inner
    hooks: list[Hook] = Field(..., title='Hooks')
    fallback: Callable[[int], int] | None = Field(None, title='Fallback')


class Deep(BaseModel):
    outer: Outer


class Model(RootModel[Holder | Deep]):
    root: Holder | Deep
